description: Defines an interface class 'resource_grid_reader' for reading resource grid data in a wireless communication system, including methods for checking emptiness, retrieving resource elements, and accessing resource views.

classes.name: resource_grid_reader
classes.description: Interface class for reading resource grid data, inheriting from resource_grid_base, providing methods to query and access resource elements.

methods.name: is_empty
methods.description: Checks if a specific port is empty (no data written since last zero set).

methods.name: is_empty
methods.description: Checks if the entire resource grid is empty (no data written since last zero set).

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves resource elements at a specific port and symbol, filtered by a bitmask.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves resource elements at a specific port and symbol, filtered by a bitmask (cbf16_t version).

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves resource elements at a specific port and symbol, selecting every 'stride' element starting from k_init.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a consecutive block of resource elements at a specific port and symbol starting at k_init.

methods.name: get_view
methods.description: Provides a view of all resource elements for a specific port and symbol.
